# metamcp_endpoint (Data Source)

Looks up an existing MetaMCP endpoint by name or UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing endpoint by name, or by UUID.
data "metamcp_endpoint" "tools" {
  name = "tools"
}

# The URL an MCP client connects to.
output "tools_url" {
  value = data.metamcp_endpoint.tools.url
}

# Read back from the server, not from configuration: a public endpoint is
# reachable by every user, not only its owner.
output "tools_is_public" {
  value = data.metamcp_endpoint.tools.is_public
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Endpoint name. Exactly one of `uuid` or `name` must be set.
- `uuid` (String) Endpoint UUID. Exactly one of `uuid` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `enable_api_key_auth` (Boolean)
- `enable_oauth` (Boolean)
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the endpoint is public. MetaMCP encodes this as the absence of an owner.
- `namespace_uuid` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `use_query_param_auth` (Boolean)
